wayback._eras_note: earlybird.com ran five site generations and no generic era parser fits them: 1999-2001 frames (/en/portfolio/investment/<co>.html, /en/portfolio/it_tele/, /en/portfolio/healthcare/), 2002-2010 (/en/portfolio/a_z/, /recent/, /healthcare/, /communication/ and /en/exits/ipos/ + /trade_sales/, with the press-release archive under /en/press/), 2010-2013 TYPO3 (/en/companies/tech.html and /health-tech.html, each company at /en/companies/<desk>/<portfolio|exited>/<slug>.html), 2014-2024 a one-page site and then WordPress (/portfolio/), and from 2025 the Framer site (/companies/<slug>). scratch/eb_archive.py reads the raw captures (Common Crawl by WARC range request, data/filings/commoncrawl/earlybird-venture-capital/, manifest sources/wayback/cc-manifest.json; Internet Archive captures under sources/wayback/raw/) and writes sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json in wayback-pull's shape, every row carrying its exact capture_url (COLLECTION.md s1: a capture URL is a valid citation). Common Crawl was the archive during the Internet Archive's machine-wide cooldown of 2026-10-06 (Erik 2026-09-26, PRO-158).

roster._note: The roster is curated (sources/wayback/partner-roster.json) from the live team pages of both sites (earlybird.com/members/<slug>, health.earlybird.com/members/<slug>), the archived team pages 2001-2013 (/en/team/..., Common Crawl and Internet Archive captures), the Form ADV Schedule A of Earlybird GmbH & Co. KG (CRD 341941) and the deal-partner fields of the portfolio records themselves. The old site's advisory boards (adv_board_eur, ab_usa: Jeffrey Pfeffer, Ronald Cape, Alexander Dibelius and others) are advisers, never deal partners, and are kept out so their names cannot attribute a Form D seat. The Digital East partners (Cem Sertoglu, Evren Ucok, Mehmet Atici, Dan Lupu before 2024) are listed with the lineage 'digital-east' in the roster's basis and are not swept as home-desk partners (decisions.md D2).

site_api._entry_stage_note: The live list's 'Stage' column (Pre-Seed / Seed / Series A / Series B) sits beside 'Status' and 'Location' with no label saying whose stage it is. It is scored against the book's documented entry rounds before it may label a row (COLLECTION.md s5: eligibility first, then the score); until then entry_stage_fields stays empty and the value rides in the item as evidence (stage_site). First reading 2026-10-06: 'Pre-Seed' is on Aiven (entered at the 2019 Series A), Snyk, Isar Aerospace and B2X, so at least that value behaves like a CMS default.
site_api._note: earlybird.com and health.earlybird.com are Framer builds (no CMS endpoint; escalation ladder step 5): scratch/eb_site.py joins each list page's anchors (name, status, stage, location, sector tags) with Framer's own search index (description, Founded / Invested years, founders, HQ, deal team, and on nine rows the firm's own 'Digital East Fund*' marker with its disclaimer). jobs.earlybird.com is a Getro board (scratch/jobboard-pull.py, 72 companies): a first-party list, its stage field never a label (COLLECTION.md s5).
site_api._team_note: earlybird.com/members (48 people) and health.earlybird.com/members (14), read by scratch/eb_site.py: one card per person with group, office, focus tags and title. 'Investment Team' publishes as investing, the Catalysts and the Vision Lab partner ('Venture Partners') as advisers; 'Investor Relations' and 'Operations' (finance, fund management, engineering, assistants) are left unmapped so they do not publish, except the Operating Partner and CFO, placed by name. Rolf Mathies, a founder, is listed 'In Memoriam' on the health site.

edgar._note: Entity-qualified phrases only: the bare word is also EarlyBirdCapital, Inc. (the New York SPAC underwriter, CIK 875307 / 1160548 / 1096396, CRD 28629), which appears in thousands of blank-check filings, plus Earlybird Central Inc. (Gardiner NY), Earlybird Digital, Inc., Earlybirds Learning Inc, Earlybird Advisors LLC (Kennett Square PA) and Earlybird 2011-A, L.P. (2596 Chestnut Street, San Francisco). Kickoff 2026-10-06, EDGAR name lookup: Earlybird Fund VIII GmbH & Co. geschl. InvKG (CIK 2124334, Muenzstrasse 23 Berlin, Form D 2026-05-19), Earlybird GmbH & Co. Beteiligungs-KG IV (CIK 1400513, Maximilianstrasse 14 Munich, paper Form D 2007-05-14) and Earlybird Management SA (CIK 1855761, 7 Avenue Gaston Diderich, Luxembourg; Forms 3 and 4 of April 2021, the UiPath IPO), which is the Digital East side (decisions.md D2).

desks._note: Namesakes verified by entity and address, never by name: the firm files from Muenzstrasse 23, 10178 Berlin (before that Maximilianstrasse 14, Munich, and Van-der-Smissen-Strasse, Hamburg). 'digital-east' is partitioned: the firm's own site states that those investment decisions were made by 'the separate company Digital East Fund which was operating under the licensed Earlybird brand', and that firm has traded as Bek Ventures since 2025 (decisions.md D2). A row is moved to that desk in companies/identity-merges.json ('desk'), so it leaves the published base as other_desk, preserved in excluded.json. 'health' stays in the base: Earlybird Health operates under the name and the firm presents it as its own fund family (D3).

profile._note: One exempt reporting adviser, Earlybird GmbH & Co. KG (CRD 341941; principal office Berlin, second office Munich). focus_crosswalk is empty on purpose: the site's technology tags ('Applications', 'Software Infra & Models', 'DeepTech & Hardware') each span several of the closed twelve, so a tag recompute would publish only the health and hardware slices. The firm-level focus is the portfolio's own distribution from the per-company classification, flagged derived in investor/sources.json. focus_min_companies about 4% of the 195-company base.
